issue_context.title: Proposal: Move `storage.tsdb.retention.size` out of experimental mode.
issue_context.body:
Hi All, 

I would propose to move our retention by size flag out of the experimental stage. Do we know any major issues that we have seen so far with this feature?

I know the issue of users trying to limit the size of WAL itself, which I don't think works now. Anything else that could block adding stability guarantees to this?

Ref: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/cmd/prometheus/main.go#L261
comments: It seems we have passed the lazy consensus timeout.
What is the process for moving something out of experimental? Is it essentially just a docs update?
Can I pick this up as a first contribution?
Yes. It is a doc update, which also touches code. We also need to review the docs since I think now WAL size is properly computed.

review_comments:
Although the `[EXPERIMENTAL]` tag at the front has gone, the end of the text still says:

> This flag is experimental and can be changed in future releases.
